name: Brent Comer
bio:
Brent Comer (born March 5, 1996) is an American actor. In 2024, he originated the role of Darrel 'Darry' Curtis in the Broadway musical The Outsiders, based on S. E. Hinton's coming-of-age novel.

Comer attended James Madison University and got his degree in musical theater in 2019. After graduation, his first major role was in a touring production of Les Misérables.
